text_en: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, To Philemon our dear friend and co-worker,
text_cn: 基督耶稣的被囚者保禄，和弟茂德弟兄，致书给我们可爱的合作者费肋孟，

text_en: to Apphia our sister, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church in your house:
text_cn: 并给姊妹阿丕雅，和我们的战友阿尔希颇，以及在你家中的教会。

text_en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 愿恩宠与平安，由天主我们的父及主耶稣基督赐与你们！

text_en: When I remember you in my prayers, I always thank my God
text_cn: 在我的祈祷中记念你时，我常感谢我的天主，

text_en: because I hear of your love for all the saints and your faith toward the Lord Jesus.
text_cn: 因为，听说你对主耶稣，和对众圣徒所表现的爱德与信德。

text_en: I pray that the sharing of your faith may become effective when you perceive all the good that we may do for Christ.
text_cn: 我祈求天主，为使你因信德而怀有的慷慨发生功效，使你认清我们所能行的一切善事，都是为基督而行的。

text_en: I have indeed received much joy and encouragement from your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, my brother.
text_cn: 弟兄，我由于你的爱德，确实获得了极大的喜乐和安慰，因为藉着你，圣徒们的心都舒畅了。

text_en: For this reason, though I am bold enough in Christ to command you to do your duty,
text_cn: 为此，我虽然在基督内，能放心大胆地命你去作这件该作的事，

text_en: yet I would rather appeal to you on the basis of love—and I, Paul, do this as an old man, and now also as a prisoner of Christ Jesus.
text_cn: 可是，我这年老的保禄，如今且为基督耶稣作囚犯的，宁愿因着爱德求你，

text_en: I am appealing to you for my child, Onesimus, whose father I have become during my imprisonment.
text_cn: 就是为我在锁链中所生的儿子敖乃息摩来求你。

text_en: Formerly he was useless to you, but now he is indeed useful both to you and to me.
text_cn: 他曾一度为你是无用的，可是，如今为你为我都有用了；

text_en: I am sending him, that is, my own heart, back to you.
text_cn: 我现今把他给你打发回去，【你收下】他，他是我的心肝。

text_en: I wanted to keep him with me, so that he might be of service to me in your place during my imprisonment for the gospel;
text_cn: 我本来愿意将他留在我这里，叫他替你服侍我这为福音而被囚的人，

text_en: but I preferred to do nothing without your consent, in order that your good deed might be voluntary and not something forced.
text_cn: 可是没有你的同意，我什么也不愿意做，好叫你所行的善不是出于勉强，而是出于甘心。

text_en: Perhaps this is the reason he was separated from you for a while, so that you might have him back forever,
text_cn: 也许他暂时离开了你，是为叫你永远收下他，

text_en: no longer as a slave but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me but how much more to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
text_cn: 不再当一个奴隶，而是超过奴隶，作可爱的弟兄：他为我特别可爱，但为你不拘是论肉身方面，或是论主方面，更加可爱。

text_en: So if you consider me your partner, welcome him as you would welcome me.
text_cn: 所以，若你以我为同志，就收留他当作收留我罢！

text_en: If he has wronged you in any way, or owes you anything, charge that to my account.
text_cn: 他若亏负了你或欠下你什么，就算在我的账上罢！

text_en: I, Paul, am writing this with my own hand: I will repay it. I say nothing about your owing me even your own self.
text_cn: 我保禄亲手签字：“我必要偿还。”至于你，你所欠于我的，竟是你本身；这我就不必对你说了！

text_en: Yes, brother, let me have this benefit from you in the Lord! Refresh my heart in Christ.
text_cn: 弟兄！望你使我在主内得此恩惠，并在基督内使我的心舒畅！

text_en: Confident of your obedience, I am writing to you, knowing that you will do even more than I say.
text_cn: 我自信你必听从，才给你写了这信；我知道，就是超过我所说的，你也必作。

text_en: One thing more—prepare a guest room for me, for I am hoping through your prayers to be restored to you.
text_cn: 同时，也请你给我准备一个住处，因为我希望因你们的祈祷，主必要把我赐与你们。

text_en: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends greetings to you,
text_cn: 为基督耶稣与我一同被囚的厄帕夫辣、

text_en: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
text_cn: 我的合作者马尔谷、阿黎斯塔苛、德玛斯、路加都问候你。

text_en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
text_cn: 愿主耶稣基督的恩宠，与你们的心灵同在！阿们。
